Privacy first

Your documents are
not anyone else's data.

Sensitive fields are encrypted before they are stored. Encryption keys stay in the system Keychain, protected by the security built into your Apple devices.

  • 01
    Encrypted at rest

    Document details are protected using authenticated AES-GCM encryption.

  • 02
    You approve access

    Device authentication and explicit confirmation guard sensitive disclosure.

  • 03
    Built for minimum access

    Only the document fields needed for a task should be requested and used.
